thread_text:
sam: Heads up — planning to be in Florida (Naples) from Dec 1 -> Mar 1 for the winter. Will this affect my WFH stipend or payroll withholding? :sunny:
marie: Thanks for the heads up, sam. Short answer: stipend rules allow temporary seasonal moves up to 6 months but stipend proration and tax treatment depend on payroll address & state rules. Please fill the Temporary Location Change form so Payroll can process with dates. :wave:
sam: cool — what's the form link? and will I lose benefits? I'm staying on US payroll (no contractor changes)
dylan: here's the form: https://redwood.example/hr/temporary-location-change
dylan: Quick FYI: moving to FL (no state income tax) usually means no state withholding while you're there, but payroll needs the dates to adjust withholding and unemployment insurance coverage. If you maintain MA residency, MA might still expect part-year tax reporting; we'll flag this to tax advisor.
jenna: For healthcare — your plan stays the same. Out-of-network care might be an issue if you use local providers; check telehealth options. No change to employer contributions.
marie: Stipend: for <=6 months we do a monthly proration; you'll still receive WFH allowance but taxed as usual. If your move triggers a permanent homebase change, rules differ.
sam: sweet. anything I need to do now?
marie: Submit the form with dates, update your home address in Rippling (or confirm if staying MA as legal home), and put a note in the form about insurance provider preferences. We'll triage with Payroll and Benefits.
sam: done — submitted form. thanks :thumbsup:
hr-bot: Temporary Location Change received for sam. Case #TL-2029-112. Payroll will respond within 3 business days.
dylan: saw the submission. We'll run the withholding calc and reply via thread with the expected net pay difference. If you get any MA tax notices keep us posted; we'll loop in tax counsel.
jenna: I'll check network providers in Naples and DM recommendations.
sam: appreciated — enjoy the sun everyone :sunglasses:
